overclaims.finding: The represented list describes current OpenSpore capability and bounded original correspondence; it is not evidence of original runtime equivalence or complete original format reconstruction.

contradictions.details: 0x008E0D30 is a vtable entry recorded in DM12, and 0x008E1000 is the SDK-named RegisterDatabase body sourced from DM01. DM16 should retain the address-kind distinction.
cCellGlobalsResource, direct Cell content records, cCellGame live pools, and cCellSerializableData are separate layers. Direct content decoding is not proof of persistence.

contradictions.topic: ResourceKey memory order versus DBPF identity
contradictions.details: Conceptual DBPF identity is type/group/instance, while the pinned ResourceKey memory layout is instanceID/typeID/groupID. Positional serialization without conversion is unsafe.

contradictions.topic: SDK anchors versus live entry points
contradictions.details: Several persistence addresses are SDK anchors, vtable entries, live entries, or containing-function repairs. DM17 explicitly labels these cases and leaves SaveGame and other bodies unknown where appropriate.
DM15.C002 remains unresolved; the current artifacts do not provide a stronger committed resolution sufficient to close it.
DM15.C014 remains unresolved; static decompilation and SDK naming do not justify a stronger field-level claim.

Treat names such as CreatureData, PlanetData, SpaceData, SaveData, and EventData as analytical projections unless an explicit source artifact names a literal recovered type.
Do not raise interface/vtable-only evidence to concrete runtime behavior or byte-level persistence.

Five stale line ranges can make a generated report appear to cite evidence that cannot be opened at the stated range.

final_recommendations: Keep the static/current/runtime evidence separation and do not use DM15-DM18 as original runtime or save/load oracles.
Repair the five stale ranges only after selecting verified current line spans; do not infer spans from the old decompilation lengths.

Add explicit address_kind and body_status fields for SDK anchors, vtable entries, live entries, and containing-function repairs.
